empty: No keepalive tasks yet. Click + to create one. A keepalive sends a minimal request on an interval to attempt to maintain upstream activity; failures are shown only and never cool down a channel or affect routing.

form.intervalHint: How long one full round takes: every credential gets one heartbeat per interval, divided across the credentials so only one upstream call is made at a time. Default 5 minutes; adjust to the upstream's activity rules. Queue position is not guaranteed. Each heartbeat carries a small jitter so separate tasks do not hit upstream together.

toast.partialFailed: Keepalive done: {failed}/{total} did not get through
